name: Pulser
description: Pulser is an open-source Python library for designing, simulating, and executing pulse sequences on neutral-atom quantum processors, developed by Pasqal. It gives users low-level control over laser pulse parameters and atom array configurations, with built-in emulation via QuTiP.

sources.title: Pulser: An open-source package for the design of pulse sequences in programmable neutral-atom arrays

news.title: Pulser v1.10.0 released
news.excerpt: Pasqal released Pulser v1.10.0, adding a Pauli Strings operator and new pulser.math functions (cdist, allclose), excluding DMM channels from laser noise calculations and dropping Python 3.10 support. On 17 November patch releases v1.10.1, v1.9.2, v1.8.1, v1.7.3 and v1.6.7 fixed a legacy serializer issue that allowed classmethods.
